findings_qualitative.value: 12CO shows the widest outflow cavities known for a Class I object; 13CO and C18O trace rotating, infalling envelope with a velocity gradient perpendicular to the outflow

evidence.quote: The low-velocity blue- and red-shifted 13 CO and C 18 O emission trace the rotation and infall motion of the circumstellar envelope.

claims.result: Opening angle ~150 deg, extension at least 8000 au
claims.finding: Widest cavities known in a Class I object, likely from wind-envelope interaction

evidence.quote: shows the widest outflow cavities in a Class I object known to date (opening angle ∼ 150 )

claims.hypothesis: 13CO and C18O trace infall and rotation of the envelope
claims.result: Velocity gradient at PA ~50 deg, perpendicular to the outflow

evidence.quote: The low-velocity blue- and red-shifted 13 CO and C 18 O emission trace the rotation and infall motion of the circumstellar envelope.
